scientific_integrity: Positive triple families and pairwise intersection theory are credited to prior literature. The negative exhaustive classification and global census are reported with a standalone exact verifier. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for the complex union of the 27 smooth conics, not the cubic-plus-conics arrangement or all its subarrangements. Negative triple-intersection certificates use two split good-prime specializations; historical priority is subject to independent checking.
title: Complete triple incidence and singularities of the Fermat cubic's 27 hyperosculating conics
